segments.name: Aerospace-related parts and supplies
segments.description: Designs, manufactures and sells niche aerospace and defense components for aircraft platforms, serving commercial, business jet and defense end markets.
segments.evidence: Loar's operations are organized and managed as one segment designed to offer its customers aerospace-related parts and supplies.

revenueModel.text: Aerospace and defense customers, including aircraft manufacturers and aftermarket operators, pay for proprietary niche components and aftermarket replacement products.
revenueModel.evidence: Furthermore, our products have significant aftermarket exposure, which has historically generated predictable and recurring revenue.

changes.text: The Company acquired LMB Fans & Motors in 2025, adding tailor-made high-performance fans and motors to its single segment.
changes.evidence: On December 23, 2025 , the Company acquired 100 % of the issued and outstanding equity interests and paid the outstanding debt of LMB Fans & Motors (LMB)

changes.text: The Company acquired Applied Avionics in 2024, adding highly engineered avionics interface solutions to its single segment.
changes.evidence: Incorporated in 1968, AAI designs, develops and manufactures highly engineered avionics interface solutions.
